description:
Many thanks to Asus for sponsoring this video. Check out the Asus ROG Strix Pulsar XG27AQNGV for the latest in 1440p display technology with state-of-the-art motion clarity: https://uk.rog.gg/Pulsar

Nvidia's 70-class hardware from 2018's RTX 2070 through to the latest RTX 5070 is re-examined in a tech evolution piece looking at the transformation of 1440p gaming over the last eight years. Yes, we have benchmark performance numbers, but the real story is in how optimised settings and ML-based technologies deliver the smoothest experiences for today's high refresh rate displays - and how 70-class hardware is still capable of delivering top-end rendering technologies, like path tracing. If you're on an older 70-class card and are thinking of an upgrade, here's how the landscape looks on some of the most recent and popular games.

Note: RTX 5070 was released in 2025, not 2024 as stated in the video.
